selection: Try only the two declared capture variants on development. Choose quorum5of12 if it passes; else quorum4of10 if it passes; otherwise no candidate recommended. No tuning after validation.
validation: Evaluate chosen configuration once on all five scenarios with unseen seeds; compare paired legacy on those same new inputs. No seed reuse or test-driven tuning. Results may fail.
semantics: Newest valid candidate plus newest-first greedy pairwise-compatible quorum in a bounded recent window. Rejected frames may intervene, never become fresh outputs.
